Everything we offer / Career session

Archaeology Research Proposal Lab

A half-day career session, online or at your venue

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this session you draft a concise defensible proposal outline.

It can be booked by one person or by a class. A short form before the session lets the mentor prepare for you.

What it covers

  • Question shaping
  • Review and method
  • Proposal clinic

How the time is spent

  1. Question shaping 45 min

    Research question and significance.

    You: title + question

  2. Review and method 90 min

    Literature, evidence, research ethics.

    You: annotated bibliography

  3. Proposal clinic 45 min

    Scope, work plan, limitations.

    You: revised synopsis

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Diagnose participant goals and constraints based on a pre-session questionnaire.
  • Draft a concise defensible proposal outline.
  • Leave with personalised recommendations and follow-up actions linked to verified sources.

You take away

A personal action plan with dates and checked sources.
